# `smelt.statusline`

<!-- Auto-generated by `cargo xtask gen-lua-docs`. Do not edit by hand. -->

**Availability:** Terminal UI only; raises in headless mode.

The statusline at the bottom of the screen. Register named sources with `smelt.statusline.add(name, handler)`; each repaint calls every handler and lays out the returned items by priority. `add` returns a `Reg` that removes the source. UiHost-only.

## `smelt.statusline.add`

```lua
fun(name: string, handler: fun(): smelt.statusline.Item[]?): smelt.Reg
```

Types: [`smelt.statusline.Item`](types.md#smeltstatuslineitem), [`smelt.Reg`](types.md#smeltreg)

── source registry ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
Add a named source of statusline items. `handler` runs on every repaint and
returns a list of items; errors are reported on stderr and skip the source.
Adding a name that already exists replaces that source in place, keeping its
position. Returns a `Reg` that removes this source, unless a later `add` with
the same name has replaced it.

## `smelt.statusline.invalidate`

```lua
fun()
```

Repaint after plugin-owned state changes that are not represented by a
built-in signal. Adding, replacing, and removing sources invalidates
automatically.

## `smelt.statusline.remove`

```lua
fun(name: string)
```

Remove every source named `name`.
